newsitem.title: USA: Rentrak sees Q4, full year profits.
newsitem.headline: Rentrak sees Q4, full year profits.

text.p: Rentrak Corp said Tuesday it expects income from continuing operations in the fourth quarter ending March 31 to be more than $1 million, with per-share net totaling about $0.07.
It said it expects operating net for the full year to be about $0.43 per share.
The company said analysts are forecasting full-year earnings of $0.22 per share.
First Call estimates for Rentrak were not available.
In the year-ago fourth quarter the company lost $4.5 million, or $0.37 a share, from continuing operatings. The full-year loss was $0.12 a share.
Rentrac said it expected fourth quarter revenues of $28-$30 million, compared with $31 million a year ago.
